apps.localizedDescription:
# Nightify for iPhone 0.1.13

- Organize the queue with drag reordering, Play Next, multiselect, and Clear queue. Songs added by hand stay separate from the album or playlist you started. Manage another signed-in Nightify device’s queue from Playback Devices.
- Organize playlists with folders, pins, notes, collaboration, and recovery. Import songs from Nightify and YouTube playlist links.
- Start a listening room, share a song at a specific time, and see your listening history, stats, and yearly recap.
- Try crossfade, beat matching for compatible saved songs, volume normalization, and automatic Offline Backup. Set Wi-Fi, cellular, and download quality separately.

# Nightify for iPhone 0.1.13

- Organize the queue with drag reordering, Play Next, multiselect, and Clear queue. Songs added by hand stay separate from the album or playlist you started. Manage another signed-in Nightify device’s queue from Playback Devices.
- Organize playlists with folders, pins, notes, collaboration, and recovery. Import songs from Nightify and YouTube playlist links.
- Start a listening room, share a song at a specific time, and see your listening history, stats, and yearly recap.
- Try crossfade, beat matching for compatible saved songs, volume normalization, and automatic Offline Backup. Set Wi-Fi, cellular, and download quality separately.

# Nightify for iPhone 0.1.12

- Nightify fixes the inflated duration for fragmented audio in streams and downloads. It checks each recording before playback and streams compatible audio in short segments, so playback can start before the full file loads. Each queue entry runs as a separate audio item, so an old stream or extra audio cannot continue under the next song's title.
- Open Settings → Playback → Offline mode to listen from Downloads. Saved playlists open from local storage, and downloaded songs appear immediately in Search.
- Weak connections no longer hold up the entire library while one request is slow. The player reports a stream failure inline and lets you switch to saved audio.
- Now Playing has Nightify's seek bar and a redesigned queue with separate Now playing and Up next sections. Use a song's menu to play it next or add it to the end.
- Playable downloads stay available. If Nightify identifies a damaged or mismatched download, use Download again from its song menu when online.

# Nightify for iPhone 0.1.11

- Each streamed or downloaded song now has its own playback boundary. A longer audio container can no longer extend one song's timeline through the following tracks.
- Song duration, progress and lock-screen metadata stay tied to the current song.
- Skip and Previous reconcile with the native player before choosing a queue entry, preventing a song already playing from being started again after an automatic transition.
- Seeking stays within the current song. Repeat-one continues to repeat that song.

Existing downloads use the corrected player automatically; downloading them again is not required.

Now Playing follows the active audio item as songs advance automatically. Elapsed time and duration come from the same audio item, and late notifications from a previous song can no longer advance the queue again.

Nightify skips preview-only SoundCloud recordings when a full stream is unavailable. Refresh the Nightify source in SideStore or AltStore and update in place with the same Apple signing account.

Nightify for iPhone 0.1.9 fixes shuffle. Turning shuffle on while a song plays now reshuffles everything after it immediately, and turning it off continues in the original order. Starting a playlist with shuffle keeps your chosen song first, and "Play next" stays next while shuffled.

Tapping a song in the play queue jumps to it without rebuilding or reshuffling the queue. Repeat now cycles between off, the whole playlist and one song.

Refresh the Nightify source in SideStore or AltStore and update in place with the same Apple signing account. Existing accounts, saved music, playlists and settings are preserved.

Nightify for iPhone 0.1.8 adds combined YouTube and SoundCloud song search. Matching recordings are deduplicated while live performances and other versions remain separate.

Lyrics from available providers are saved on disk for offline use. Imported files read their title/artist tags and prepare lyrics in the background; downloaded songs prepare lyrics after saving. Lyric caches stay separate for each Nightify account.

Refresh the Nightify source in SideStore or AltStore and update in place with the same Apple signing account. Existing accounts, saved music, playlists and settings are preserved.

Nightify for iPhone 0.1.7 fixes song search rows that could show a result label instead of the artist's name. Artist credits now handle multiple unlinked names and keep available artist identifiers.

Album rows that point to a music video or unavailable premium version can now play the matching song recording when title, artist and duration agree.

Icon controls remain accessible on older supported iOS versions, including password visibility and playlist download actions.
The guest-speaker option scrolls with sign-in content so it cannot cover the registration button when the keyboard is open.

Refresh the Nightify source in SideStore or AltStore and update in place using the same Apple signing account. Existing accounts, libraries, downloads and settings are retained.
